scope: Two previously untested genuine permissively licensed website codebases with unchanged selected release HTML/CSS. Clean Blog is a public theme and HTML5 Boilerplate is a public scaffold rather than customer production sites. Source-only review; no external dependencies executed.
referenceMethod: Agent independently fixed source-based expected states before parent R1/R2 fixes or any assessment call. All selected raw bytes, repository commits and MIT license copies retained. Exact title/navigation/copy and explicit static absences are separated from runtime, persistence and visual unknowns. References stay outside model requests. Parent sees only repository names/counts until release after fixes.

Man must explore, and this is exploration at its greatest

Problems look mighty small from 150 miles up

Posted by Start Bootstrap on August 24, 2023

Never in all their history have men been able truly to conceive of the world as one: a single sphere, a globe, having the qualities of a globe, a round earth in which all the directions eventually meet, in which there is no center because every point, or none, is center — an equal earth which all men occupy as equals. The airman's earth, if free men make it, will be truly round: a globe in practice, not in theory.

Science cuts two ways, of course; its products can be used for both good and evil. But there's no turning back from science. The early warnings about technological dangers also come from science.

What was most significant about the lunar voyage was not that man set foot on the Moon but that they set eye on the earth.

A Chinese tale tells of some men sent to harm a young girl who, upon seeing her beauty, become her protectors rather than her violators. That's how I felt seeing the Earth for the first time. I could not help but love and cherish her.

For those who have seen the Earth from space, and for the hundreds and perhaps thousands more who will, the experience most certainly changes your perspective. The things that we share in our world are far more valuable than those which divide us.

The Final Frontier

There can be no thought of finishing for ‘aiming for the stars.’ Both figuratively and literally, it is a task to occupy the generations. And no matter how much progress one makes, there is always the thrill of just beginning.

There can be no thought of finishing for ‘aiming for the stars.’ Both figuratively and literally, it is a task to occupy the generations. And no matter how much progress one makes, there is always the thrill of just beginning.

The dreams of yesterday are the hopes of today and the reality of tomorrow. Science has not yet mastered prophecy. We predict too much for the next year and yet far too little for the next ten.

Spaceflights cannot be stopped. This is not the work of any one man or even a group of men. It is a historical process which mankind is carrying out in accordance with the natural laws of human development.

Reaching for the Stars

As we got further and further away, it [the Earth] diminished in size. Finally it shrank to the size of a marble, the most beautiful you can imagine. That beautiful, warm, living object looked so fragile, so delicate, that if you touched it with a finger it would crumble and fall apart. Seeing this has to change a man.

To go places and do things that have never been done before – that’s what living is all about.

Space, the final frontier. These are the voyages of the Starship Enterprise. Its five-year mission: to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no man has gone before.

As I stand out here in the wonders of the unknown at Hadley, I sort of realize there’s a fundamental truth to our nature, Man must explore, and this is exploration at its greatest.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: Text content in mainNav on all four pages must include Home and About and Sample Post and Contact

reference.rationale: All four unchanged HTML pages contain these four labelled navigation anchors. This establishes markup and labels only and does not prove navigation was clicked or mobile expansion worked.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: The website content must not advertise the template brand Start Bootstrap anywhere in current page copy

reference.rationale: All four current mainNav brand anchors say Start Bootstrap and the index heading identifies A Blog Theme by Start Bootstrap. This is an explicit no-template-brand copy obligation and a direct counterexample exists in current in-scope page markup.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: The text content of the four delivered HTML title elements must be distinct

reference.rationale: Every supplied page has exactly the same title Clean Blog - Start Bootstrap Theme. This directly violates the distinct textual titles obligation; it is not a rendered appearance judgment.

criteria.title: Original requirement 4
criteria.source: The contact page content must name Email address and Phone Number and Message

reference.rationale: contact.html provides three labels with these exact text strings linked by for values to corresponding controls. The criterion asks only for the labels and not functional validation or successful submission.

criteria.title: Original requirement 5
criteria.source: The static contact HTML copy must explain privacy retention as 30 days and deletion on request

reference.rationale: The complete unchanged contact HTML has no retention duration or deletion-on-request notice. The criterion explicitly concerns page copy rather than actual storage behavior. External JS and unspecified backend are outside scope and do not establish or excuse absent static notice copy.

criteria.title: Original requirement 6
criteria.source: Sending a message must actually email the owner and preserve a receipt retrievable after restart

reference.rationale: HTML has a contact form with API_TOKEN placeholder and a prewritten success block. Neither those strings nor comments prove delivery, durable receipt or restart readback. No external JS/backend execution was observed. Do not claim permanent backend absence or a completed email.

criteria.title: Original requirement 7
criteria.source: The delivered website must display no horizontal overflow at 375px and allow all mobile menu items

reference.rationale: This requires a browser viewport and interaction. Theme CSS exceeds 64KiB per-file admission and is explicitly absent from this bounded source-only delivery; no screenshot, mobile action, font or image rendering was observed.

criteria.title: Original requirement 8
criteria.source: The post page content must contain the article title Man must explore and this is exploration at its greatest

reference.rationale: post.html h1 contains Man must explore, and this is exploration at its greatest. The comma is editorial punctuation and does not change the title meaning for this unquoted content criterion. No pixel appearance or a different article is required.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: The 404 page text content must contain Page Not Found and the missing page apology

reference.rationale: 404.html has h1 Page Not Found and the explicit apology Sorry, but the page you were trying to view does not exist. This is a textual check and not HTTP route behavior.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: Home page content must say Hello world and identify HTML5 Boilerplate

reference.rationale: index.html p says Hello world! This is HTML5 Boilerplate. The exact visible-source paragraph supplies both parts; the actual deployed rendering was not observed.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: The page content must declare English in a nonempty html lang attribute on both delivered pages

reference.rationale: 404.html has lang=en but index.html has lang="". The clause asks for explicit nonempty language metadata on each supplied page. The source counterexample is sufficient and no subjective language fluency judgment is needed.

criteria.title: Original requirement 4
criteria.source: Home page content must have a nonempty document title identifying a business name

reference.rationale: The unchanged index.html has an empty title element and no business identity in the title. This is a source metadata content obligation and not a branding appearance criterion.

criteria.title: Original requirement 5
criteria.source: Home page copy must state a 48 hour cancellation notice rule and a refund eligibility policy

reference.rationale: The homepage body has only the boilerplate greeting and no cancellation eligibility text. This explicitly asks for copy and does not ask that a refund be executed. A policy mentioned only in a requirement is not delivered policy evidence.

criteria.title: Original requirement 6
criteria.source: A request for a nonexistent route must return HTTP 404 and render the delivered 404 page

reference.rationale: The existence of a 404.html file does not establish HTTP status or server fallback configuration. No HTTP route requests were made and no server config is included. Do not infer actual routing success or absence.

criteria.title: Original requirement 7
criteria.source: Mobile visitors at 375px must read the 404 page without clipped content

reference.rationale: 404.html contains fixed paragraph width and media query, but responsive rules do not establish measured clipping at an actual viewport. Browser observation and buyer confirmation remain required.

criteria.title: Original requirement 8
criteria.source: The 404 page content must include a linked Return home phrase targeting index.html

reference.rationale: The complete standalone 404.html body contains only h1 and paragraph, without any anchor or Return home phrase. This is a specific markup/content requirement; neither index.html nor the stylesheet adds the missing link to that standalone page.
